subject: Kickoff: fractal language metrics track
body:
Team — kicking off the fractal language metrics track.

The research establishes that language is self-similar and long-range dependent — Hurst parameter around H=0.70 — and, more usefully for us, that fractal parameters improve on perplexity-based bits-per-byte for predicting downstream performance. Product angle: a corpus-quality scoring service. If the self-similarity exponent S, Hurst exponent H, and Joseph exponent J computed over a candidate data mix predict downstream evals better than BPB, that changes how data-platforms prices and prioritizes corpora.

Plan: (1) reproduce the parameter-estimation pipeline from the released colab by Feb 27; (2) compute fractal parameters across five internal corpus slices in March; (3) a correlation study against our existing downstream eval suite in April; (4) readout and Q3 proposal by May 1.

Wei owns estimation, Rafael the correlation study, Gustavo pipelines, Amara data access. Daniela follows up on resourcing.

Priya
